name: Payment Regulatory Information Notification V 04
definition: The PaymentRegulatoryInformationNotification message is sent by the reporting party to the registration agent to provide details on the transaction, when a payment has to be recorded against the registered currency control contract. ||In some cases, the registration agent may also sent this message to the reporting party.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Characteristics shared by all individual items included in the message.

TransactionNotification.name: Transaction Notification
TransactionNotification.definition: Notification of information related to a regulatory reporting on a payment.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
